question: Can I choose my preferred workshop for accident repairs?
answer: HDFC Assurance Motor policy gives you the freedom to choose your own workshop in Singapore. However, if you choose to use our HDFC Assurance Approved Workshop for repair, you can be assured that genuine manufacturers’ parts are used and it comes with a full 9 months repair warranty. Own Damage Excess will be halved if you choose to repair your vehicle at our HDFC Assurance Approved Workshop. To view the list of HDFC Assurance Approved Workshops, please click here .

question: If I am not at fault for the accident but make an own damage claim, will my NCD be affected?
answer: Your NCD will not be affected if we can recover the claim amount from the other party. However, if the claim recovery is not successful, your NCD will be affected. Alternatively, if you have been successful in your counter claim for excess and loss of use (at least 80% success rate), we can look into your request to reinstate NCD, subject to supporting documents.

question: If I make a claim for Windscreen, do I have to reinstate my windscreen cover after a claim? Will my NCD be affected?
answer: For HDFC Assurance Motor policy, your windscreen cover will be automatically reinstated at no cost to you without affecting NCD.

question: If the other party offers private settlement, should I agree?
answer: You should have the settlement in writing from the other party, if he/she offers private settlement. Call our HDFC Assurance Claims Hotline at 6922 6003 for assistance, if necessary.

question: What is market value? How is this determined?
answer: Market value is the cost of replacing the Insured Vehicle with a vehicle of the same make, model, condition and age of the vehicle at the time of the accident. This may be determined by the latest transactions sourced from newspaper advertisements, online motoring websites, surveyors and motor car dealers.

question: What is the No Claim Discount (NCD) Protector? How does it work?
answer: The NCD protector is an optional benefit and applies only to policyholders of 50% NCD at an additional premium. It will protect your NCD in the event of a first claim during your policy period. If a second claim is made, the normal NCD rules apply and your NCD will be reduced to 20% on your next policy renewal. The protected NCD is not transferable to another insurer. You will need to renew your policy with HDFC Assurance in order to enjoy this benefit.

question: What should I do if my car is stolen?
answer: You will need to lodge a police report immediately so that the Police can investigate the matter. Please also report the loss to us, together with a copy of your police report.

question: When is the Young and/or Inexperienced Driver Excess applicable?
answer: The Young and/or Inexperienced Driver Excess is applicable in addition to the Own Damage Excess amount specified in the Schedule if the Insured Vehicle is driven by or under the control of any person (other than the Policyholder) who at the time of loss or damage to the Insured Vehicle is below twenty-seven (27) years of age and/or has held a valid driving license for less than two (2) years.

question: When will the renewal or new car insurance policy information be transmitted and updated into LTA database for Road Tax Renewal?
answer: The data will be transmitted to LTA in real-time/near real-time.

question: What are the Terms and Conditions for Car Protect360 Insurance?
answer: You can find out more about our Terms and Conditions for Car Protect360 Insurance here.

question: Who can buy Choice Protect360?
answer: You are eligible to purchase this Policy if You are between the ages of eighteen (18) and sixty-five (65) years old. You must be a Singapore citizen, Singapore permanent resident, expatriate or foreigner who holds a valid pass and is ordinarily residing in Singapore.

question: Does this policy have age restrictions?
answer: Yes, the main policyholder must be between 18 and 65 years old at the start of the policy, renewable up to 70 years. For children, coverage is from 1 to 18 years old, or up to 25 if studying full-time. Age calculated as at last birthday.

question: What does Choice Protect360 cover?
answer: Choice Protect360’s key benefits are: Up to $500,000 coverage in the event of Accidental Death and Permanent Disablement. No Claim Discount of up to 10% of the premium. Up to $10,000 of Accidental Medical Reimbursement (including infectious diseases). Up to $250 Daily Hospital Income in the event that you sustain injury and was hospitalized. Purchase Protection of $5,000 and free dependent child cover (for Accidental Death and Permanent Disablement, Accidental Medical Reimbursement, Mobility Aid & Ambulance Services Reimbursement)

question: How does No Claim Discount(NCD) work?
answer: You can receive a 5% discount after one (1) year of no claim, and a maximum of 10% after two (2) or more consecutive years with no claim.

question: Does Choice Protect360 cover Child(ren)?
answer: Yes, unmarried children who are between 1 to 18 years old (or up to 25 years old if studying full time) will be covered for free, as long as a Family Plan is purchased.

question: Is there a discount if I choose a family plan?
answer: Yes. When you opt for a family plan with spouse coverage, you’ll enjoy a 10% discount on the Personal Accident premium. Plus, your child(ren) is automatically covered at no additional cost for Personal Accident benefits (for Accidental Death and Permanent Disablement, Accidental Medical Reimbursement, Mobility Aid & Ambulance Services Reimbursement).

question: How do I make a claim?
answer: You can submit the claim form, along with the supporting documents by fax to 6224 1923, email to claims@hdfc.com.sg or post it to HDFC Assurance’s office at 11 Keppel Road, #11-01 ABI Plaza, Singapore 089057. To file a travel insurance claim, you may submit your claims online.

question: What happens if I miss my payment due date?
answer: A late fee may be charged if the minimum amount due is not paid by the due date on your statement. The exact fee is shown on your statement. Please arrange payment or a promise-to-pay as soon as you can.

question: Is there a grace period after the due date?
answer: Some products allow a short grace period before a late fee is posted. Whether your account is still in grace is account-specific — we can confirm from your account position after verification.

question: My EMI auto-debit bounced. What should I do?
answer: The installment stays outstanding and bounce charges may apply per your product schedule. You can set a promise-to-pay date or request a callback to update your mandate. We cannot reverse bounce charges on this call.

question: Can you waive the late fee?
answer: Late-fee waivers need supervisor review. I can log your request and arrange a specialist callback — I cannot approve a waiver on this call.

question: Can I restructure my loan or settle for less?
answer: Restructuring and settlement need a documented review. I can note your interest and escalate to a specialist. I cannot quote settlement percentages or approve restructuring live.

question: I lost my job / I am in financial hardship. What are my options?
answer: I am sorry you are going through this. We can schedule a hardship-review callback so a specialist can discuss options. If you prefer, I can also connect you to a human agent now.

question: When will I get an NOC after clearing my dues?
answer: An NOC or account-closure letter is issued only after the outstanding balance is cleared and internal checks finish. Same-day issuance is not guaranteed.

question: Why do you need my mobile last 4 digits?
answer: We verify identity before sharing any account details so your information stays private. Please share the last 4 digits of your registered mobile.

question: Is this call recorded?
answer: Yes. Collections calls are recorded for quality and compliance.

question: What is the difference between Early Protect360 Plus and Early Protect360?
answer: The Early Protect360 Plus is an enhanced version of the previous Early Protect360, offering new and upgraded benefits as such: End-stage kidney failure coverage ICU benefit coverage Sum assured has been increased from the previous 30% to the current 100% Yearly renewable coverage has been extended from the previous limit of 75 years of age to 99 years of age

question: Who is eligible to be insured under Early Protect360 Plus?
answer: You can apply for this Policy if you are between the ages of 18 to 65 years old. The policy is renewable up to 99 years of age and will terminate when the Insured Person attains 100 years of age. You must be a Singapore Citizen, Singapore Permanent Resident, or a foreigner holding a valid pass issued by the Singapore government and residing in Singapore.

question: Is Early Protect360 Plus a renewable plan?
answer: Yes, it can be renewed by paying the required premiums, up until the Insured Person reaches the maximum renewable age of 99 years old. Your policy will be reviewed and premium rates may change at the policy renewal date.

question: What is the maximum coverage I can purchase under Early Protect360 Plus?
answer: You can purchase up to $300,000 worth of coverage under Early Protect360 Plus.

question: Is there a free-look period?
answer: Yes, there is a fourteen (14) day free-look period from the date of delivery of the policy. During this period, if you decide not to take up the policy, we will refund the premiums paid unless something has occurred for which a claim may be payable.

question: Do I need to go for a medical check-up?
answer: A medical check-up is not required for this policy. You will, however, be required to answer a 3-question health declaration to find out if you are eligible to purchase Early Protect360 Plus.

question: How does the ICU benefit work?
answer: In the event you are admitted to the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) and treated with continuous life support devices for four (4) consecutive days or more. We will pay 20% of the Benefit Limit, subject to a maximum of $25,000. This benefit can only be claimed once during the period of insurance. The payment of ICU Benefits will not reduce the Benefit Limit amount.

question: How do I make a claim under Early Protect360 Plus?
answer: You can submit the claim form, along with the supporting documents by fax to 6224 1923, email to claims@hdfc.com.sg, or post it to HDFC Assurance’s office at 11 Keppel Road, #11-01 ABI Plaza, Singapore 089057.

question: What are the Terms and Conditions for Early Protect360 Plus?
answer: Please refer to the full Terms and Conditions for Early Protect360 Plus here.

question: Can I purchase more than one Fraud Protect360 Plus plan?
answer: Yes, you can purchase up to two (2) Fraud Protect360 Plus plans; either Silver and Gold or Silver and Platinum plans.

question: Who is covered under Fraud Protect360 Plus?
answer: You as an individual or You and your spouse as described in the policy schedule. The policy does not extend to other family members.

question: Who is eligible to be insured under Fraud Protect360 Plus?
answer: You must be between the ages of eighteen (18) to sixty-five (65) years old. You must also be a Singapore Citizen, Singapore Permanent Resident, or a foreigner holding a valid pass issued by the Singapore government and residing in Singapore.

question: What is covered under Fraud Protect360 Plus?
answer: It covers Online Shopping Fraud, Fund Transfer Fraud, Cyber Extortion, Restoration Costs and Identity Theft. It also covers Personal Accident benefits such as Accidental Death and Permanent Total Disablement, Accidental Medical Reimbursement, Hospital Cash Benefit, Hospital Cash Benefit – ICU and Emergency Medical Transportation.

question: What is not covered under Fraud Protect360 Plus?
answer: Refer to the below key exclusions: Love or Confidence Scam; Face to face ransom; Online Gambling; Online Auction; Corporate or Business Cyber Liability; Cyber Operation; Digital Currency Maintenance Costs; Legal Proceedings (without HDFC consent); Reimbursable Fraud Loss (any financial loss that is reimbursable by Your Personal Account, Payment Card company, bank or other financial institution). For the full exclusions of Fraud Protect360 Plus, please refer to the section “Exclusions Applicable To Cyber” on page 6 of the policy wordings.

question: What are the policy wordings for Fraud Protect360 Plus?
answer: Please refer to the full Policy Wordings for Fraud Protect360 Plus here.

question: Does the policy cover corporate cyber attacks?
answer: No, it only covers personal/individual cyber events.

question: What is covered under Online Shopping Fraud?
answer: It covers situations where you were dishonestly induced to purchase goods from an online merchant but the goods were not delivered — within 30 days of the scheduled arrival date (or a later date the merchant informs you), or within 60 days from the first date of purchase if no scheduled arrival date is provided — and the merchant did not provide a full or partial refund or take remedial action within 60 days of the scheduled arrival date.

question: What is covered under Fund Transfer Fraud?
answer: It covers the following Fund Transfer Fraud events: The fraudulent electronic transfers of funds from Your Personal Account by a Third Party; Fraudulent transfer of funds or property from Your Personal Account to a Third Party after being defrauded, with the first e-communication being unsolicited and first sent to you via Email, SMS or WhatsApp; and The fraudulent unauthorised use of or electronic transfer of funds stored in Your personal Digital Wallet held by an Online Merchant.

question: What is covered under Cyber Extortion?
answer: It covers extortion payments made to a third party due to cyber extortion threat, as well as fees for experts appointed to advise or respond to the threat.

question: What is covered under Restoration Cost?
answer: It covers the costs to investigate, repair damage, retrieve or replace digital assets, remove malware, and restore your computer system after unauthorised access, or malware infection by a third party.

question: What is covered under Identity Theft?
answer: It covers reasonable expenses and legal costs incurred to re-establish your reputation such as correcting or reinstating public records, dismissing or withdrawing civil or criminal records, enrolment and registration support for single credit monitoring or copying charges and registered mail postage for sending the required documentation and loan reapplication (if any) after an identity theft event involving online theft or misuse of your personal data by a third party to commit fraud.

question: Who is eligible for Home Protect360 Insurance?
answer: The House Owner and/or Tenant occupying the insured premises. You must be a Singapore Citizen, Singapore Permanent Resident, or a foreigner holding a valid pass issued by the Singapore government and residing in Singapore.

question: Why should I enrol for Home Protect360 Insurance?
answer: Home Protect360 Insurance offers a wide range of protections for your home, be it a HDB BTO, condo, or landed property, encompassing accidental loss or damage to household contents, renovations, fixtures and fittings, electronics, and fixed glass and mirrors. Additionally, it covers the loss of money stored in drawers or safes, the replacement of locks and keys, and compensates for the spoilage of food and drinks. This comprehensive coverage ensures that your home and valuables are safeguarded against various risks. Please refer to the Policy Wording for full details.

question: Following household contents’ damage arising from fire, can I claim for the Removal of Debris?
answer: Yes, you can claim the expenses incurred on the Removal of Debris, dismantling or demolishing, shoring up or propping the property, up to the sum insured.

question: Can I claim for the loss of my jewellery?
answer: Yes, We have enhanced our cover on Valuables under Section 1 and Optional Cover Section 10. Please refer to the Summary of Benefits for their respective coverage.

question: Can I claim if my television insured under this policy accidentally fell and damaged?
answer: Yes, you can be assured that your home contents will be replaced or reimbursed.

question: How do I make a claim for my home contents?
answer: You can submit the claim form, along with the supporting documents by fax at 6224 1923 or email at claims@hdfc.com.sg. Alternatively you can post it to HDFC Assurance office at 11 Keppel Road #11-01 ABI Plaza Singapore 089057.

question: What are the Terms and Conditions for Home Protect360?
answer: You can find out more about our Terms and Conditions for Home Protect360 here.

question: Who can apply for this Hospital Income Policy?
answer: You can apply this Policy if you are between the age of 18 to 65 years old. You must be a Singapore Citizen, Singapore Permanent resident or expatriate or a foreigner who is holding a valid employment pass, work permit, dependent pass, student pass or long term visit pass and ordinarily residing in Singapore.

question: Can I claim under both Section 1 and Section 2 for the same day of hospitalization?
answer: No, you can only claim under either Section 1 or 2 for the same day of hospitalization due to an accident or illness.

question: How many days of hospitalization is covered?
answer: In the event that you sustain an injury or illness during the period of insurance and is considered medically necessary by a Medical Registered Practitioner that you will be hospitalised to receive in-patient treatment. For each injury and illness: Up to 365 days under Section 1 – Daily Hospital Cash or Up to 30 days under Section 2 – Triple Daily Hospital Cash (in ICU) benefit.

question: Does this policy cover me while I am overseas?
answer: Yes, you are covered while you are overseas. If you are away from Singapore, it shall be a period of not more than one hundred and eighty-three (183) days during the Period of Insurance.

question: Does this policy premium increase with age?
answer: Yes, the premium will increase upon renewal of the policy, if the insured’s age during renewal entered into the next age band.

question: Does this policy cover hospitalization in a rehabilitation centre or a community hospital?
answer: No, rehabilitation centre and community hospitals do not meet the definition of a hospital under the policy which means an institution lawfully operated for the care and treatment of injured or sick persons with organized facilities for diagnosis and surgery, having twenty-four (24) hours per day nursing services by legally qualified registered nurses and medical supervision under Registered Medical Practitioners.

question: Is there a waiting period for Hospital Protect360 insurance?
answer: There is a waiting period of 30 days from the effective date of your policy for claims that are due to illness. There is no waiting period if the claim is due to injury because of an accident.

question: What does the “No Claim Bonus” benefit mean?
answer: If no claim has been made under this policy after twelve (12) consecutive months, we will refund you 20% of the premium that you have paid at the end of each annual period. Provided that: There has been no interruption of cover for a period of twelve (12) consecutive months. Premium has been fully paid.

question: What does the “Special COVID-19” benefit cover?
answer: The benefit pays you up to the benefit limit if you are diagnosed with COVID-19 during the Period of Insurance and is considered medically necessary by a Registered Medical Practitioner that: You will be confined in an Intensive Care Unit (ICU) in a Hospital for more than five (5) days, or In the event of your death as a direct result of contracting COVID-19.

question: Am I allowed to change my hospital income insurance plan type, i.e. upgrade or downgrade my plan?
answer: You may choose to upgrade your plan type upon the annual renewal of your policy, subject to approval.

question: Does Hospital Protect 360 insurance pays on top of other insurance policies I have?
answer: For Section 1 to 4, the benefits are payable on top of other insurance policies that you have, subject to each benefit limit.

question: How do I make a claim for my Hospital Protect 360 insurance?
answer: You can submit the claim form, along with the supporting documents by fax to 6224 1923, email to claims@hdfc.com.sg or post it to HDFC Assurance’s office at 11 Keppel Road, #11-01 ABI Plaza, Singapore 089057.

question: What should I do if I have further enquiries on Hospital Protect360?
answer: Please contact HDFC Assurance Customer Care Hotline at (65) 6702 0202 (Mon – Fri, 9.00 am – 6.00 pm) or email your questions to service@hdfc.com.sg. Our relationship officers will be happy to assist you.

question: What does Maid Protect360 PRO cover?
answer: Maid Protect360 PRO provides comprehensive and high-value coverage for all employers and their domestic helpers in Singapore. Our maid insurance plan covers payout on Hospital and Surgical Expenses, Personal Accident protection, Alternative Maid services, Waiver of 25% Co-Payment (for Enhanced plans and above) and even outpatient privileges for the maid with subsidised consultation fee for medical and dental services.

question: Does Maid Protect360 PRO fulfil MOM’s latest requirements, and which plan should I buy?
answer: Maid Protect360 PRO fulfil MOM latest requirements. Learn more here. We offer higher tier Premier and Exclusive plans for those who prefer to have more coverage and higher protection for their maid. There are also high value add-ons for you to boost your maid insurance coverage.

question: What is so special about Maid Protect360 PRO?
answer: Maid Protect360 PRO is designed for you and your helper. It provides comprehensive benefits to protect the maid which include Personal Accident, Hospital and Surgical Expenses, Replacement Maid Services, Insurance Guarantee Bond, Personal Liability to Third Parties and other benefits. In addition, your helper gets dental and medical coverage, alternative maid services and the waiver of co-payment. Your helper can also enjoy a subsidised rate for dental and GP medical consultation at our panel of clinics. In addition to the comprehensive insurance coverage mentioned above, Maid Protect360 PRO also provides you with optional coverage under Enhanced Medical Benefits which includes: Critical Illness up to $10,000 Mobility Aid Reimbursement up to $500 Free medical teleconsultation up to 3 times for you and 3 times your helper annually

question: Is there a Free-Look period?
answer: No, there is no free look period.

question: How does security bond works?
answer: HDFC Assurance will issue a Letter of Guarantee for the sum of $5,000 as a security bond on your behalf to the MOM. With this, you do not need to pay the $5,000 cash upfront to MOM when you are applying for a maid. If a demand is made by MOM, HDFC Assurance will make the payment first and recover it from you under the Counter Indemnity arrangement of the insurance. You may like to purchase the optional cover for a waiver of the Counter Indemnity in respect of the Letter of Guarantee to the Ministry of Manpower (MOM), paying only $250 for the Excess for your account. By availing this option, you are relieved from the obligation of making an upfront payment of $5,000 in cash to the MOM while applying for a maid in Singapore.

question: What do Medical Expenses benefit and Hospital & Surgical Expenses benefit cover?
answer: We will reimburse the Insured (your domestic helper) for Hospitalisation and Surgical Expenses (including Day Surgery) incurred in Singapore as a result of an accident and/or sickness sustained by the maid during the period of insurance.

question: What does Replacement Maid Services cover?
answer: This benefit reimburses you the actual expenses incurred for the termination and agency fees for hiring a replacement maid during the period of your maid’s hospitalisation due to death or permanent disablement. The replacement maid will need to be employed within thirty (90) days of your maid’s death or repatriation.

question: When are some of the conditions when my maid’s hospital & surgical costs are not claimable under Maid Protect360 PRO?
answer: The Policy excludes pre-existing medical conditions and also communicable disease of the maid. If the injury is pre-existing, or due to suicide, pregnancy, influence of drugs etc, such conditions will also not be claimable under maid insurance.

question: Can I get a refund when I cancel my policy?
answer: Either you or HDFC Assurance can cancel the policy by giving the other party 14 days’ notice in writing. If you cancel the policy, you will receive a short period refund of premium paid for the unexpired period of the maid insurance. The amount refund is dependable by the period of when you cancel the policy.

question: How do I make a claim?
answer: You can submit the claim form, along with the supporting documents by fax at 6224 1923 or email at claims@hdfc.com.sg. Alternatively, you can post it to HDFC Assurance office at 11 Keppel Road #11-01 ABI Plaza Singapore 089057.

question: What are the Terms and Conditions of Maid Protect360 PRO?
answer: You can find out more about Terms and Conditions for Maid Protect360 PRO here.

question: When should I purchase my maid insurance? What date should I use as the start date for the insurance plan?
answer: It is advisable to submit the application at least 3 working days before the start date of the maid insurance. This is to allow time for us to transmit the security bond and your maid’s insurance details to MOM. Maid TypeDescriptionStart Date For Maid Insurance New Maid Hiring maid for the first timeOn or before the maid’s arrival date in Singapore Renew Maid Existing maid who is currently in Singapore and working for youOne day after the expiry date of the current work permit Transfer MaidYou’re taking over maid who is currently working in Singapore Policy start date - The agreed transfer date which is also the day you apply for issuance of the maid’s new work permit

question: What do I need to prepare before applying for Maid Protect360 Pro?
answer: You will need the following details to apply for the Maid Insurance: In-Principle Approval or Renewal letter from MOM Maid’s passport details Visa / Master card details for payment

question: How does the MOM Insurance Guarantee Bond and the Waiver of Counter Indemnity work?
answer: We will issue a Letter of Guarantee for the S$5,000 security bond on your behalf to MOM. If MOM makes a demand, we will first make the payment and recover the payment from you under the policy conditions of Section 9 (Refer to the policy wordings) Suppose you opt for the optional cover for Waiver of Counter Indemnity. In that case, you only need to reimburse us the excess amount of S$250, provided that the payment is not caused by or resulting from your breach of conditions under the Security Bond.

question: Does Maid Protect360 PRO pay for COVID-19 related medical bills?
answer: If your domestic helper is diagnosed with COVID-19 and hospitalised, we will reimburse the eligible medical expenses under Section 2 (Hospital & Surgical Expenses).

question: What does Alternative Maid Services cover?
answer: Alternative maid services pay for the cost of hiring temporary help if your helper is hospitalised due to injury or illness. The payout per day ranges from $100 to $200 for Enhanced, Premier and Exclusive Plans. We have also arranged a special rate with our partner to assist you if your helper is unable to perform their duties, you will receive an email from us notifying you of the promotion code. Simply use the promotion code at checkout to enjoy the special rate.

question: How do I redeem the free teleconsultation services?
answer: If you have opted for the Enhanced Medical Benefits, you will receive an email from us to assist you to download an app in order to register for up to three (3) free teleconsultations each, for both you and your maid.

question: What does Maid Protect360 PRO Insurance cover?
answer: We provide comprehensive maid insurance coverage for both you and your helper of 4 levels with diverse limits: Basic, Enhanced, Premier, and Exclusive. Though the limits vary, the cover is broad and has everything you’re looking for in a maid insurance plan. All plans cover the following benefits: Personal Accident Benefits Highest Hospital Cash Payout Alternative Maid Services Hospitalisation and Surgical Expenses Waiver of Co-payment for Hospital & Surgical Expenses (Enhanced Plan and above) Free Medical Tele-consultation for both you and your helper (Enhanced Plan and above) Guarantee bond to Ministry of Manpower (MOM)

question: Can you send a payment link?
answer: Yes, I can send a secure payment link to your registered channel.

question: Who can apply for this Policy?
answer: You can apply this Policy if you are between the age of 18 to 65 years old. You must be a Singapore Citizen, Singapore Permanent resident or a foreigner holding a valid pass issued by Singapore government and is residing in Singapore.

question: Can my children be included in the Family Protect360?
answer: Yes, unmarried children who are between 1 to 18 years old (or up to 25 years old if studying full time) will be covered for free, as long as Family Plan is purchased.

question: What are the general exclusions for Family Protect360?
answer: You can find out more about our general exclusions for Family Protect360 here.

question: How does this Policy pay out for Income Protector?
answer: In the event of Permanent Total Disablement, this Policy will pay a monthly benefit up to the maximum sum assured stated. However you must be gainfully employed at the time of Accident.

question: Does this Policy premium increase with age?
answer: No. The Policy premium is not affected by age and does not increase as you get older.

question: Do I need to inform HDFC Assurance upon the annual renewal of this Policy?
answer: No. If you pay the premium and observe the terms and conditions of your Policy, it will be automatically renewed every year as long as its approved by us.

question: How do I make a claim for my Family Protect360 Insurance?
answer: You can submit the claim form, along with the supporting documents by fax to 6224 1923, email to claims@hdfc.com.sg or post it to HDFC Assurance’s office at 11 Keppel Road, #11-01 ABI Plaza, Singapore 089057.

question: What should I do if I have further enquiries on Family Protect360?
answer: Please contact HDFC Assurance Customer Care Hotline at (65) 6702 0202 (Mon – Fri, 9.00 am – 6.00 pm) or email your questions to service@hdfc.com.sg. Our relationship officers will be happy to assist you.

question: What are the Terms and Conditions for Family Protect360?
answer: You can find out more about the Terms and Conditions for Family Protect360 here.

question: What does Travel Protect360 Insurance cover?
answer: We provide comprehensive travel insurance coverage of four (4) levels with diverse limits: Basic, Silver, Gold, and Platinum. Though the limits vary, the coverage is broad and has everything you’re looking for in a travel insurance plan. All plans cover the following travel benefits: Overseas Medical Expenses (Child, Adult, Senior / Elderly) Medical Expenses in Singapore Personal Accident: Accidental Death & Permanent Disablement Travel Inconvenience Travel Postponement Travel Misconnections Insolvency of Travel Agency (Excluding Basic Plan) Trip Disruption Flight Inconvenience and Diversion Hijack of Common Carrier Kidnap & Hostage (Excluding Basic Plan) Personal Liability Loss of Home Contents Credit Card Protections (Excluding Basic Plan) Rental Car Excess Enhanced Medical Benefits due to COVID-19 (Excluding Basic Plan) Enhanced Travel Inconvenience, Cancellation, Postponement or Curtailment due to COVID-19 (Excluding Basic Plan) Chat with us if you have any questions via WhatsApp and we will be happy to answer your queries!

question: How to buy travel insurance from HDFC Assurance?
answer: Buying your travel insurance from HDFC Assurance is a straightforward process. You can purchase your desired policy online. Simply visit our travel insurance section, select the plan that suits your needs, and follow the steps for a hassle-free purchase experience.

question: Annual Trip Insurance vs Single Trip Insurance - Which is better?
answer: Single Trip Travel Insurance provides coverage for the destination you’ve indicated. Meanwhile, an Annual Trip Travel Insurance gives better value should you have already planned to go on more than two trips in the year.

question: Does Travel Protect360 Insurance cover me if I travel to multiple countries?
answer: Please indicate the countries you will be travelling to when you buy your travel insurance online. If you’re wondering where to buy travel insurance online, simply visit our website’s travel insurance section for a seamless online purchase experience.

question: Can I buy travel insurance after departure?
answer: No, travel insurance should be purchased before your trip commences.

question: Can I cancel my travel insurance policy if my plans change?
answer: You may cancel the Policy before the start of your trip with administrative charges applicable.

question: Can I extend my travel insurance coverage if my trip is extended?
answer: Yes. This is subject to our underwriter’s approval. You can call or email us before the policy expires. If you’re wondering where to buy travel insurance for extended trips, you can easily do so through our website or contact our customer support at 6702 0202 for assistance.

question: What should I do if I lose my money or travel documents during my trip?
answer: If your loss arises out of robbery, burglary or theft, you should report the loss to the local police within 24 hours after the loss / incident and obtain a written statement from the police to substantiate your travel insurance claim.

question: What should I do if I need assistance while overseas?
answer: One of the benefits of our travel insurance is the 24 hours Travel, Emergency Medical and Evacuation Assistance which provides for loss of travel documents and baggage, air ticket arrangements, emergency medical evacuation, referral services for interpreters / translators, legal, embassy, hospital admission and other medical facilities etc. These services are available 24/7 by calling our Hotline at (65) 6922 6009.

question: Are adventure activities and indoor / outdoor sports covered by Travel Protect360 insurance?
answer: No. Our travel insurance does not cover adventure activities. You can find the list of exclusions in our policy wording.

question: Can I continue my medical treatment for injury or sickness sustained overseas when I return to Singapore?
answer: Yes, follow-up treatment in Singapore is covered within thirty (30) days after your return from the trip, provided that you have sought initial treatment overseas for Bodily Injury or Sickness during your trip and such initial treatment is claimable under Section 1 of the of the policy wording. If you have purchased our Pre-Existing Medical Conditions coverage add-on, please note that it only covers medical expenses incurred overseas and emergency medical evacuation. Follow-up treatment in Singapore for pre-existing medical conditions is not covered under this add-on.

question: If I was injured or sick overseas but did not seek medical treatment, can I do so upon my return to Singapore?
answer: Yes. The Company will indemnify you up to the Benefits Payable under the Policy for the treatment sought within three (3) days after your return from the Trip where initial treatment for Bodily Injury or Sickness was not sought overseas, up to a maximum of thirty (30) days from the date of first treatment in Singapore, and subject to a limit of S$100 per visit.

question: I am currently under medication for some medical conditions. Can I claim for medical expenses related to these medical conditions during the trip?
answer: Under our standard Travel Insurance Policy, pre-existing medical conditions are not covered. However, if you purchase our Pre-Existing Medical Conditions Coverage add-on, you can claim for overseas medical expenses and emergency medical evacuation related to your pre-existing medical condition, up to the benefit limits stated in your policy, and provided that you are fit to travel and not travelling against the advice of any Registered Medical practitioner due to your pre-existing medical condition. You may refer to our policy wording for more information regarding our Pre-Existing Medical Conditions coverage.

question: If I am pregnant, am I covered for any medical treatment incurred overseas?
answer: No. Our travel insurance policy does not cover any pregnancy-related issues.

question: Is dental treatment covered while I am overseas?
answer: Yes, dental treatment is covered (as a result of Bodily Injury only).

question: Will I be covered if I am going overseas to receive medical treatment?
answer: No. The travel insurance plan does not cover you if you are travelling contrary to the advice of any Qualified Medical Practitioner or for the purpose of obtaining medical treatment.

question: What does the Pre-Existing Medical Conditions add-on cover?
answer: This add-on provides coverage for stable and controlled medical conditions that existed before purchasing the policy, such as asthma, diabetes, or high blood pressure. It covers: Overseas Medical Expenses – If you require medical treatment abroad due to a pre-existing condition. Emergency Medical Evacuation – If you need to be medically transported due to a covered pre-existing condition. Please note that follow-up treatment in Singapore is not covered under this add-on.

question: What does the Flight Delay add-on cover?
answer: This add-on enhances your travel inconvenience coverage by reducing the minimum flight delay time required for compensation. With this benefit: Claim eligibility begins after just 3 hours of flight delay, rather than the standard 6-hour waiting period. You may receive $100 compensation for every 3-hour period of delay, starting from the 3-hour mark. This add-on is especially valuable for travellers with connecting flights or time-sensitive itineraries.

question: What does the Loss of Frequent Flyer Miles add-on cover?
answer: If your trip is cancelled or postponed, this add-on reimburses the value of your unused, pre-paid, and non-refundable air ticket that was purchased using frequent flyer miles. Reimbursement is based on the value of miles at the time of claim submission. Only applies to non-refundable flight redemptions.

question: What is the time frame for submitting a travel claim when I return to Singapore?
answer: You will need to submit a claim within thirty (30) days upon returning to Singapore.

question: What happens when I submit a claim?
answer: Within 3 business days of receiving your claim, we will send you an acknowledgement. We will request for additional documents within 7 business days if claim documents are incomplete. Once we receive all necessary information and have completed a full investigation required to assess your claim, we will decide to accept or decline your claim and inform you of our decision within 7 business days.
